name: How long does hardwood flooring installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does hardwood flooring installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of hardwood flooring installation varies based on the project's size and complexity. For an average-sized room, installation might take 1-3 days. Larger or more intricate projects, such as multiple rooms or areas requiring extensive subfloor preparation, could extend to a week or more. This estimate typically includes time for subfloor leveling, material acclimation, installation, and any necessary finishing touches. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size, typically 1-3 days for an average room or up to a week for larger projects.
